title: Christmas and Winter Coloring Pages Bundle
author: TheChristmasLady
description:
Christmas and Winter Coloring Pages Bundle
Bundle with 20 coloring pages in winter/ Christmas theme.
These coloring pages can be printed at home to be colored with pencils, markers, crayons, etc..
The files have a white background, not a transparent one and they are offered as PNG files.
Bundle details:
* 20 High-Resolution PNG files with winter-themed coloring page designs
* Size: 8.5 in. x 11 in. (21 cm. x 29.7 cm.) = standaard printing A4 size paper
Get this great bundle for just $5!
